title: Accelerated Death Benefit for Terminal Illness: Whole Life Insurance Limits Schedule
content:
An insured under a Whole Life Insurance policy who is certified to have a life expectancy of 12 months or less may receive part of the death benefit in advance. The limits, fee and discount are set per Ashgrove tier.

| Tier | Largest share of the face amount that may be accelerated | Largest acceleration on one insured across all Ashgrove whole life policies (USD) | Certified life expectancy at or below which the insured qualifies | Processing fee deducted from the advance (USD) | Actuarial discount on the elected amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 50% (0.5) | 20000 | 12 months | 100.00 | 6.5% (0.065) |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | 80% (0.8) | 500000 | 12 months | 150.00 | 6.5% (0.065) |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 80% (0.8) | 500000 | 12 months | 150.00 | 6.5% (0.065) |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | 80% (0.8) | 500000 | 12 months | 150.00 | 6.5% (0.065) |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 80% (0.8) | 500000 | 12 months | 150.00 | 6.5% (0.065) |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | 80% (0.8) | 500000 | 12 months | 150.00 | 6.5% (0.065) |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical)

- A certified life expectancy of 12 months qualifies; 13 months does not.
- On a Final Expense policy with a face of 30000 dollars, 50% of the face is 15000 dollars; on a 20-Pay policy with a face of 30000 dollars, 80% is 24000 dollars.
